caption: Epic orchestral trap instrumental at 90 BPM, like a fighting game boss theme recorded with a real orchestra and a hip-hop producer. Thunderous live drums and taiko hits, hard snare, trap hi-hat rolls, a distorted 808 bass. A concert grand piano plays a menacing ostinato, real tubular bells and church bells toll, string section stabs, brass swells, a dark analog synth lead. Big, polished Hollywood mix with natural reverb, instrumental, no vocals.
lyrics:
[Intro - solo grand piano and ringing bells]

[Verse - hard live drums and deep 808 bass come in]

[Hook - full arrangement, bells and synth pad swell]

[Outro - piano and bells alone]
